A self-proclaimed 'time traveller' has made a chilling prediction about a future discovery from the ocean depths that will allegedly alter the course of human history

07:00, 11 Sep 2026Updated 09:45, 11 Sep 2026

A self-proclaimed 'time traveller' from the year 2198 has issued an alarming forecast about a oceanic discovery that will supposedly transform the trajectory of human civilisation.

‌

TikTok account @timetravelexplorer has generated fascination with bold assertions that a being, presently thought to exist solely in our fantasies, dwelling in the ocean's depths will be uncovered over the coming two decades.

‌

The purported time traveller voyager has shared a chronology outlining when these revelations will take place, starting in 2044.

‌

The footage, mysteriously titled "at least they exterminate them", has already accumulated more than 1,300 likes as the supposed chronological jumper left social media users astounded with their latest forecasts.

‌

The recording opens by declaring that in 2044, "humans finally discover the ocean deeper", suggesting researchers will probe further into the marine abyss than previously achieved.

Based on the TikToker's account, three years afterwards, "a creature that once was a children's myth becomes reality". Yet by 2054, several examples of this species are located, resulting in their elimination by humanity within that same year.

Despite the alleged time wanderer's prophecies, many TikTok viewers remain doubtful. One individual commented: "You do realise that since you told us this, you messed with the time and space continuum, so now it won't happen."

Another user added: "You can say it to get attention but its not true," while a third questioned: "How come the government ain't told us about you if you real?".

A fourth quipped: "Ah yes, don't tell the FBI or something but make a TikTok."
